title: APO Pork Tenderloin with Pear-Fennel Gravy
description: Tenderloin medallions cook in full steam and are coated with a mild pear gravy scented with fennel and Bavarian mustard.
equipment: Anova Precision Oven Gen 1 with food probe, bottom drip pan and middle wire rack

ingredients.name: lean pork tenderloin
ingredients.note: Silver skin and visible fat removed.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Use plain broth made from meat, bones and water without a vegetable seasoning blend.

ingredients.name: smooth Löwensenf Bavarian mustard
ingredients.note: Pass through a fine sieve if grainy.

steps.title: Preheat the APO
steps.text: Fill the water tank and install the bottom drip pan. Preheat to 155°F with sous vide mode on, 100% steam, rear element on, top and bottom elements off. Set the food probe target to 145°F.

steps.title: Cut the medallions
steps.text: Cut {pork} across the grain into 1/2-inch medallions. Arrange unbagged in the pan on the middle rack and slide the probe horizontally into the thickest piece. Begin cooking immediately and set a separate 12-minute reminder for the first temperature check; respond sooner if the probe signals.

steps.title: Soften the pear
steps.text: While the pork cooks, simmer {pear}, {broth}, {fennel} and {garlic} in the HexClad over medium-low heat for 6–8 minutes, until the pear crushes easily.

steps.title: Smooth the sauce base
steps.text: Press the pear and broth through a fine sieve into a bowl, scraping the underside. Return the smooth base to the skillet and whisk in {mustard}.

steps.title: Make the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Bring the sauce base to a simmer. Whisk in the freshly stirred slurry and keep it bubbling gently for 1 minute, until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Steam the pork
steps.text: Cook for about 15–35 minutes, checking from 12 minutes. Verify 145°F in the center of each piece.

steps.title: Rest in the juices
steps.text: Remove the pan and rest the medallions loosely covered in their juices for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Nestle and sauce
steps.text: Arrange the pork in the warm pear gravy, turning once to coat each face. Spoon extra gravy over the medallions.

notes: Make ahead: Finely grate the pear directly into the broth to keep its color light. The sauce base can be chilled one day ahead. For a gentler gravy, leave out the mustard and add a little more pear. Refrigerate promptly in shallow portions and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Pear and gravy keep the thin medallions moist for up to 2 months in the freezer. Fridge reheat: Place one portion and its sauce in a shallow covered dish. Install the APO bottom drip pan and preheat to 325°F, sous vide mode off, 60% steam, rear element on, top and bottom off. Insert the probe in the coldest center and set it to 165°F. Start checking after 12 minutes and heat to 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw a single portion in the refrigerator overnight, then use the fridge reheating method. Stir the sauce until smooth. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 203 kcal, 30.8 g protein, 10.7 g total carbohydrate, 3.4 g fat, 1.6 g fiber, 91 mg sodium. Includes the measured broth and sauce. Sodium varies with your broth.
